_comment: Baseline scores per (department, metric); the prompt optimizer (pipelines/optimizer) also reads this file. Departments not yet observed are absent from `aggregates`, and every section is intentionally empty: no reviewer-approved measured numbers exist and none are fabricated. The Tier 2 PR runner (evals/run_evals.py) and the Tier 4 continuous-eval job that were meant to populate this file were retired together with the legacy /chat, /hitl and /harness endpoints they exercised, so numbers must come from a reviewer-approved run. Findings from the post-reskin trial run (2026-09-09) that made the aggregates unreliable: (1) the Foundry SDK evaluators still send `max_tokens` which the gpt-5.x deployments reject; (2) FOUNDRY_JUDGE_DEPLOYMENT was not set so the triage rubric could not run; (3) work_order_completeness needs the raw resolution JSON but the orchestrator returned prose.
